title: Patch Notes 1.20.0
body:
# Patch Notes 1.20.0

Raiders,

Patch 1.20.0 is now deploying across all platforms. You will need to restart your game to grab the download.

* A new Rawhide Outfit is available.

* Two additional haircuts have been added.

* Il Toro balance adjustments:

* **Dev Note:** This change responds to a lot of community requests. We've retuned the Il Toro to bring its DPS and long-range performance in line, particularly in combination with a choke attachment. We're also adjusting it so its behavior better matches its rarity tier, meaning it will be less flexible at low upgrade levels and rely more heavily on upgrades and mods to reach its full potential. The biggest changes are to fire-rate and reload speed, both of which have been lowered, so positioning, cover, and good timing will matter more when using it against enemies. We'll keep monitoring how this plays out and will make further tweaks if they're needed. Thanks for the feedback and for bearing with us.

* Pellet Damage lowered from 7.5 to 7

* Base Fire-Rate lowered from 43 to 38

* Base Dispersion raised from 4.5 to 6

* Total Reload Time extended from 4.3s to 5.7s

* Looping Reload Entry extended from 0.8s to 1s

* Looping Reload Time extended from 0.5s to 0.7s

* Damage loss from Falloff increased from 40% to 50%

* Fixed a bug causing lingering audio to play from Comets and Fireballs after they were destroyed.

* Fixed a bug that let players get pushed through a wall and become trapped in the Dam Controlled Access Zone.

* Fixed missing collision near the east elevator and beneath the pipes on Spaceport.

* Lowered the sell price of Energy Clips from 1000 coins down to 200 coins.

* **Dev note:** Energy Clips had become an unintentionally high-profit item to craft, so we're cutting the sell price to bring its profitability back in line with other craftable items.

See you topside,

Ossen
